title: Rainforest 4 Purchase Portion of Daintree Rainforest with the help of the APT Foundation
author: Ian
body:
Thanks to generous donations from several organisations, including the APT Foundation, Rainforest 4 Foundation have recently purchased 9 hectares of the Daintree Rainforest, preserving a small portion of this invaluable eco-system for another generation.

The Daintree Lowland Rainforest is one of the oldest rainforests on Earth having survived undisturbed for over 120 million years. It holds exceptionally high biodiversity and conservation value and is the largest continuous area of tropical rainforest remaining in Australia. Due to extensive deforestation, the forest and the rare and endangered species living there are under threat.

The recent lot purchases total 11 properties secured by Rainforest 4 Foundation, who work collaboratively with Jabalbina Yalanji Aboriginal Corporation and non-profit partner HalfCut. Securing these lots means that these areas will not be impacted by development and will aid the protection of threatened species including Southern Cassowary, Bennett’s Tree-Kangaroo, and seven species of plants.

You can help support Rainforest 4 Foundation and help return the Daintree Rainforest to its former glory. A $50 donation will buy back 20 square metres of the Daintree Rainforest. More information can be found through our Rainforest 4 Foundation page.
